free_resources.title: Three Free Somatic Sessions
free_resources.description: Three free sessions from Dayana Pereira: a talk on how stress and hard experiences settle in the body, a Feldenkrais-inspired body-awareness lesson, and an eight-minute daily check-in practice to return to.

left_out: Individual sessions (dayana.io/sessions): sold on reducing chronic pain and 'faster, more supported recovery' from injury or surgery, after a health-history intake; reads as treating physical conditions (and is bodywork rather than spiritual teaching), so still out.
Performance sessions for golf and tennis (dayana.io/performance): sports performance coaching; out of scope, not a health matter.

DailyOM course 'The Feldenkrais Way to Heal the Body': dailyom.com's robots.txt header prohibits any robot or automated retrieval without written permission, so the site was treated as blocked and not fetched.
flags: Session 1 is titled 'What Trauma Does to the Body'; it explains stress physiology and makes no treatment claim; kept.
